definition: GOLOG is a high-level logic programming language for the specification and execution of complex actions in dynamical domains.
details: It is based on the situation calculus. It is a first-order logical language for reasoning about action and change. GOLOG was developed at the University of Toronto.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. Here is the short version: GOLOG is a high-level logic programming language for the specification and execution of complex actions in dynamical domains. The part that makes it sing: It is based on the situation calculus. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is GOLOG — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
